name: agent-receipt-verify
description: Checks x402 endpoint conformance before an agent pays, and links the receipt to its settlement.

tools.name: check_x402_endpoint
tools.description: Before paying: which levels of a published conformance ladder a paid endpoint reaches, measured with one request and without paying.

tools.name: link_receipt_to_settlement
tools.description: After paying: whether the receipt opens to exactly one real on-chain settlement, answering linked, not linked, or could not check.
